'''2007 Worlds Day 2 David McCune DS No Money, No Parts, No Deal!''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[David McCune]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[David McCune]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|No Money, No Parts, No Deal! / You're A Slave?|Cor-D-nomoneynopartsnodeal.gif|label=No Money, No Parts, No Deal!}}
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
